transport: ANT+ FE-C full serial frames received as FEC2 BLE notifications
extractionRule: Retain only QZ Characteristic change notification lines containing one exact A4 09 4E 05 + 8-byte page + XOR frame; exclude application-generated transmit/control lines.
privacy: Bluetooth addresses, absolute times, unrelated traffic, and physical device-name suffixes are excluded. Relative time begins at each session first retained frame. Common Page 81 serial bytes are zeroed and its XOR checksum recomputed.
